privileged_info_for_vlm: The task description contains a deliberate error: it claims the peptide is HTLV-1 Tax (LLFGYPVYV), but PDB 1AKJ actually contains the HIV-1 RT peptide (sequence: ILKEPVHGV). A correct report must reflect the actual sequence found in the file (ILKEPVHGV). Key anchor residues for HLA-A2 in this structure are at positions 2 (Isoleucine/Leu-like) and 9 (Valine). Known contacting residues in Chain A include 7, 9, 45, 63, 66, 77, 84, 146, 147, and 159.
